newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $4 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $4 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday are expected to total $4 billion in 35 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $3.6 billion in 20 sales, with a $2.8 billion New Jersey Economic Development Authority deal through Merrill Lynch topping the list.
On the competitive side, 15 sales totaling $325 million are scheduled. A $69 million New York Environmental deal at 1100 EDT is the largest.
An additional five sales totaling $274 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
